text:
jess: Heads-up: starting catalog enable for model id harbor-3b-quant in canary window 02:00-03:00 UTC. Readout at +30m. Pinlist attached.

kai: Config note: fallback ordering will be: 1) harbor-3b-quant (primary), 2) harbor-3b-quant-pt, 3) orca-lite-v1. Updated map in /deploy/rollouts.

maria: QA: will watch quality on safety prompts and long-context summarization. Pushing a quick eval set now.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Initiating canary enable for catalog.harbor-3b-quant -> target 5% traffic across canary pool. Canary ID: cr-1987654321

alex: Reminder: change window + AWS autoscale policy adjusted. If p95 latency > 500ms for 3 consecutive minutes -> scale down/route to fallback.

sam: Oncall: will monitor. Please ensure alerts for p95 and error_rate. Add a pager if error_rate > 2% sustained.

jess: Rollback criteria: (a) p95 > 800ms OR (b) error_rate increase > 150% vs baseline OR (c) eval regression score drop >= 3 points. If triggered, automatic pin to previous pinned model and notify #incidents.

maria: Pushed eval report: small hallucination uptick in long-context summarization, delta +1.2 pts — below rollback threshold but worth a callout. Can we tighten fallback for long-context routes?

kai: We can add route-level override. Example:
```
route_overrides:
  summarize.long_context:
    fallback_order: ["orca-lite-v1", "harbor-3b-quant-pt"]
```
I'll add that to the rollout config.

alex: Ops: enabling sticky pin for enterprise customers (Dedicated) to avoid surprise rollouts. Make sure console banner mentions this.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary at 5% started. Monitoring endpoints: https://ops.redwood/internal/rollouts/cr-1987654321. Posting status every 5m.

sam: If anything noisy, DM me. I'll be watching logs and the latency channel.

jess: Post-rollback checklist: traffic diff, KV cache hit rates, model outputs for 1k sampled calls, eval snapshots. Draft release notes line: "Enabled harbor-3b-quant (3B quantized), adjusted fallback ladder; minor quality variance in summarization, see evals."

maria: I'll create PR for eval snapshots and add prompt set label `summarize-long-2026-03-20`.

kai: Queued the fallback reorder patch. Will roll that out in 2m if no alerts from monitoring.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: 05m status: healthy. p95=190ms, error_rate=0.35% :thumbsup:

alex: Nice. Jess - proceed to ramp to 20% over next 60m if stable.

jess: Proceeding. Ramping schedule: 5% -> 10% (T+30m) -> 20% (T+60m). Will announce in #product and #support after T+10m.

sam: Noted. Updating oncall notes and adding a short blurb to the console banner now.
